# Banque Palatine

> > Banque Palatine is a French bank specializing in private banking, wealth management, and ETI (mid-sized enterprise) financing, offering digital solutions through ePalatine platforms.

Banque Palatine serves private clients, businesses, and regulated professionals with personalized banking services, including the ePalatine Suite for cash management, Palatine Premium wealth services, and dedicated support for ETI financing. The bank is part of Groupe BPCE and emphasizes digital transformation, corporate social responsibility, and cultural patronage.

## Key Topics

- ePalatine Suite - Multi-bank cash management platform
- ePalatine Certification - Strong authentication & e-signature
- Palatine Premium - High-net-worth client services
- ETI (Entreprises de Taille Intermédiaire) - Mid-sized enterprise focus
- METI - Movement of mid-sized enterprises
- Wealth management (gestion-patrimoine)
- Life insurance products
- Securities operations (OST)
- EBICS protocol integration
- Digital banking services
- Employee benefits & meal vouchers
- Property management banking
- Para-athlete sponsorship
- Contemporary art patronage
- Digital transformation

## Digital Banking Platforms

- [ePalatine Suite - Banque Palatine](https://www.palatine.fr/entreprises/gerer-flux-moyens-paiement/epalatine-suite): Multi-bank cash management platform with EBICS protocol integration
- [Sécuriser vos opérations - banque Palatine](https://www.palatine.fr/entreprises/gerer-flux-moyens-paiement/securiser-operations): Strong authentication & e-signature solutions via ePalatine Certification
- [Services numériques et dématérialisation de documents : franchissez le pas ! | Banque Palatine](https://www.palatine.fr/clients-prives/hub-de-contenu-clients-prives/services-numeriques-et-dematerialisation): Digital services & eDocument dematerialization via ePalatine platform

## Private Banking & Wealth Management

- [Promesse Palatine Premium | Banque Palatine](https://www.palatine.fr/clients-prives/clients-premium/promesse-palatine-premium): Palatine Premium service privileges and personalized wealth management
- [L'assurance vie - Banque Palatine](https://www.palatine.fr/clients-prives/valoriser-capital/lassurance-vie): Life insurance products: Palatine Avenir, Concerto, Intermezzo contracts
- [Opérations sur Titres (OST) | Banque Palatine](https://www.palatine.fr/clients-prives/valoriser-capital/operations-sur-titres-ost): Securities operations management via ePalatine under SRD2 directive
- [VIP - Votre information Patrimoniale : Le marché américain et les management packages](https://www.palatine.fr/clients-prives/hub-de-contenu-clients-prives/vip-votre-information-patrimoniale-vip-votre-information-patrimoniale-le-marche-americain-et-les-management-packages): VIP episode on US markets & management packages with PAM experts

## Business & Enterprise Services
